_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::ssti#3 — half confirmed, half falsified. On upstream ssti_mono_3D_3hex8_elch_s2i_butlervolmerthermo_growthlaw.4C.yaml, deleting ELCH CONTROL aborts with 'Invalid type of closing equation for electric potential!' from scatra_ele/4C_scatra_ele_parameter_elch.cpp, exit 1, with no result test reached — so the section is required, but the failure is an abort, not a silently zero Butler-Volmer current. The SCATRATIMINTTYPE half is impossible as stated: the key is not in SSI CONTROL for SSTI, the upstream electrochemical deck omits it entirely (UPSTREAM_SETS_SCATRATIMINTTYPE=0), and SSTI CONTROL's own SCATRATIMINTTYPE has exactly one legal value — 4C answers any other with "'SCATRATIMINTTYPE' has wrong value, possible values: Elch". Adding an SSI CONTROL block with SCATRATIMINTTYPE: Elch to an SSTI deck parses and changes nothing. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Invalid type of closing equation for electric potential!
'SCATRATIMINTTYPE' has wrong value, possible values: Elch

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the ELCH CONTROL arm: keep the section. The abort vanishes and EXIT_NOELCHCTRL becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the SCATRATIMINTTYPE arm: do not inject an illegal value. The possible-values line vanishes and EXIT_WRONGTYPE becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
